luiskr.com / website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing / measureFit

function measureFit(c, observedWidth?): void;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing.ts:65

Decides whether the items fit side-by-side (no carousel chrome) or need the scroll track. Side-by-side requires: ≤2 items, viewport ≥ SIDE_BY_SIDE_BREAKPOINT, and projected total width ≤ host width. The projection mirrors the shadow-DOM contract in media-figure.scss + carousel-host.scss exactly: strip height is --mf-h (70dvh minus a pad under 1024, fixed $space-* steps above) clamped to the file's natural height, media width is aspect-driven and capped by the regular gutter cap, the landscape --mf-max-w ladder, AND the natural pixel width (calcMediaBox — WASM-backed, never upscales), floored at min(MEDIA_MIN_WIDTH, naturalW) on ≥375px viewports; each item adds its breakpoint padding + desktop side margin. Items missing intrinsic sizes use GENERIC_DIMENSIONS defaults (conservative portrait) so a partial CMS row can't silently flip to scroll mode.

Parameters

c

CustomCarousel

observedWidth?

number
